title: LibUsdOracle 1e24/price no zero-check: frozen feed reverts, DoSing sunrise
description: In the encodeType 0x01 branch, getTokenPriceFromExternal returns `uint256(1e24).div(LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice(addr, FOUR_HOUR_TIMEOUT, lookback))`. LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice — through both getPrice() and getTwap() — is explicitly documented and coded to RETURN 0 (not revert) when the feed is broken or frozen: it returns 0 on a decimals() revert, a latestRoundData() revert, roundId==0, or a stale/invalid timestamp/answer (LibChainlinkOracle.sol L67/L79/L81/L87 and L109/L121/L123/L151/L161). When that 0 is fed into `1e24.div(0)`, the division reverts (LibRedundantMath / Solidity panic 0x12) instead of degrading gracefully. The whole pricing call therefore reverts during a feed outage, contrary to the 0-sentinel contract the rest of the file relies on. This is DT-007 and violates ARITH-003. (Note: this DoS is independent of the inverted ternary in DT-006/OR-001 — whichever helper is selected, a frozen feed yields 0 and the unguarded division reverts.)
impact: When a Chainlink feed backing a whitelisted token (encodeType 0x01) is frozen, stale beyond FOUR_HOUR_TIMEOUT, or reverting, every consumer of getUsdPrice/getTokenPriceFromExternal for that token reverts instead of receiving the documented 0 sentinel. Consumers include the sunrise oracle step and convert pricing; a reverting price call can block season advancement and conversions for the affected token during the outage. Temporary availability DoS gated by an external feed condition (not attacker-triggered). Medium under Immunefi v2.2 (temporary DoS of a core flow). Strong KB precedent (Solodit ~0.58: Chainlink frozen/phase-change feed DoS, Medium).

ice_chain.impact: Pricing call reverts during a feed outage, blocking season advancement / conversions for the affected token until the feed recovers.
ice_chain.consumer_function: sunrise/oracle step and convert pricing consumers of LibUsdOracle.getUsdPrice / getTokenPriceFromExternal
ice_chain.exploit_path: feed frozen/stale -> LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice returns 0 -> 1e24.div(0) reverts -> caller (sunrise/convert) reverts
